23:55 Local Time, 10:55 GMT, 16:25 IST: With a convincing win, New Zealand have pulled one match back in the 5-match series. For once, the Indians failed to understand the ground's dimensions and paid the ultimate price. The bowlers struggled to find their line and length, allowing Glenn Phillips and Michael Bracewell to enjoy themselves. While chasing 259, India lost two wickets in the first over and were never in the race from there on. Abhishek and Shreyas Iyer got a start, but the big chase required them to take risks. They took those risks and failed. The visitors lost half their side inside the first 10 overs and the writing was on the wall. A 87-run loss - a big one in the context of the series - and the home team will be chuffed with the eventual result. Presentations coming up shortly..
